notes.title: OSX/Linux beta version released!
notes.content:
We've just pushed out the beta version for OSX/Linux all previous issues have been resolved. Please let us know if there's any crash bugs.

[b]Known issues[/b]:
[list]
[*] [spoiler]MC name does not change after a event[/spoiler]
[*] ending movie has weird playback issues
[/list]

notes.title: OSX/Linux alpha version released!
notes.content:
We just released the OSX and Linux versions of WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.01. This is running on Ren'Py and has some bugs and missing features that we'll be adding/fixing.

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Preferences screen is a mess
[*] Sprites sometimes overlap each other
[*] Text sometimes messes with the interface
[*] Audio sfx sometimes does not play
[*] Music overlaps sometimes
[*] Movies don't play
[*] CG mode doesn't exist
[*] Music mode doesn't exist
[/list]

Please let us know if you run in to any crash bugs.
